summary: Standardized custom RFID cards for vibe-coding projects: a tray-printing ID card app, a 3D-printable RFID reader enclosure, and the Wish It Better framework.
amended: v1.0.1 — §1/§4: the account-free route is the minimum, not the issue tracker
_note: Level is L1. wish_channel is the wishing well on the landing page, not a mailto: a mailto is account-free but it is not a queue — it has no status, no ordering, and it made a human's inbox the precondition for anything happening. The well needs no account, no mail client and no address, and it lands in a queue an agent works. verify_pages_artifact.mjs proves the declared page actually carries the well rather than trusting the URL.
